title: Trial state transition
statement: For a Boolean list $d$, form a new encoded state whose first component is the first component extracted from $d$. Its second component encodes the list obtained by dropping from a length encoding the prefix specified by the extracted length data and first component of the second component of $d$, together with a singleton Boolean list. That Boolean is the conjunction of the first component of the third nested second component of $d$ and the trial test applied to the first component of $d$ and the corresponding prefix of the length encoding.
caveat: The pairing, length, prefix, and trial-test operations are not defined in the supplied context.
